questions.question: Which PR scope do you want for the OP-01 review results (audit-025, record changes, /observe harness fix)?

options.label: Audit + record, harness filed (Recommended)
options.description: One PR, under BK-485: audit-025 plus record changes. The harness lesson becomes a new backlog item with a dossier, because changing RFC-0024's method needs its own ADR or RFC and review loop. Small and quick to merge.

options.label: All three in one PR
options.description: Audit, record changes and the /observe skill change plus an ADR in one PR. Covers everything at once, but mixes a process change into a record PR, which makes the PR bigger and its review longer.

options.label: Audit only
options.description: Only audit-025 plus a BACKLOG pointer. You decide the record changes and the harness work later, from the audit.

questions.question: How should the OP-01 record be adapted to the findings (C1 to C7, the gaps, the evidence for O14/O15)?

options.label: Add reopen items O17+ (Recommended)
options.description: Follows the skill's step 4 and the O14 to O16 precedent: each finding becomes an open item naming the artifact, the conflict and the dependent decisions. The D-entries stay as they are, and step 5 can't write the affected spec clauses until the reopens are decided.

options.label: Run the reopens now
options.description: I put each reopen to you as a dialog (options, recommendation, source) and update the D-entries plus their consistency checks. The record is then free of contradictions, at the cost of about 10 dialog rounds in this session.

options.label: Leave the record alone
options.description: The findings live only in the audit. The record stays as merged, and step 5 reads the audit next to it.

questions.question: What shape should the /observe harness lesson take?

options.label: Both steps (Recommended)
options.description: A whole-record consistency pass at the End step (stays unprimed) plus a separate review step after the session that does look at code and backends. Covers both blind spots; the second needs an RFC-0024 amendment.

options.label: End-step pass only
options.description: Only the whole-record consistency pass inside the session. No method change, but backend realities (C3, C5) keep slipping through until step 5.

options.label: Backend review step only
options.description: Only the separate review step. Catches backend realities and, done properly, whole-record contradictions too, but finds them later and costs more.
